name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::insert_range

declarations.code:
template <container - compatible - range<CharT> R>

constexpr iterator insert_range(const_iterator pos, R &&rg);

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 iterator before which the characters will be inserted


 rg

 -

 a container compatible range

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator which refers to the first inserted character, or pos if no characters were inserted because rg was empty.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
If std::allocator_traits<Allocator>::allocate throws an exception, it is rethrown.

If the operation would cause size() to exceed max_size(), throws std::length_error.

If an exception is thrown for any reason, this function has no effect (strong exception safety guarantee).
